description: Creates or changes an API secret, so the app can call an external API with neblla.api.call(name, path, body) without exposing the key: Neblla inserts the value where {secret} appears in headers or query and calls only under baseUrl. The value is never shown back. Call bytes count against the app's quota. Waits in the app's queue until neblla_promote "save". Deleting: neblla_delete_api_secret. More: neblla_get_llms tools/set_api_secret

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

baseUrl.description: The only place it may call (https, a public host).

fromClient.description: true: the app's browser code (and a Fog's room.js, which runs on the player's device) may call it too, as any visitor; they use it but never see the secret.…

headers.description: Sent on every call; {secret} marks where the value goes, e.g. { "Authorization": "Bearer {secret}" }.

limits.description: { loggedInOnly, perUser: { minute … month }, app: { day, month } }; absent or 0: none.

name.description: The secret's name: a letter, then letters, digits or _ (up to 40), e.g. CLOUDINARY.

query.description: Query parameters on every call, e.g. { "key": "{secret}" }.

value.description: The secret, up to 8 KB. Required on create and whenever baseUrl, headers, query or fromClient change; otherwise left out keeps it.

name: neblla_set_api_secret
title: Save an API secret
